c74object.name: neural~
c74object.digest: Neural~: Load and run NeuralAudio models in real time
c74object.description: Neural~: Load and run NeuralAudio models in real time.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Report current model status to the status outlet
method.description: Report current model status to the status outlet.

method.name: load
method.description: Load a model file. Accepts absolute or relative paths; spaces in filenames are handled. Relative paths are resolved against the patcher's directory first, then Max's file-search path.

attribute.name: quality
attribute.digest: Model quality scale factor: 0.0 (fastest / lowest quality) to 1.0 (slowest / highest quality)
attribute.description: Model quality scale factor: 0.0 (fastest / lowest quality) to 1.0 (slowest / highest quality). Only affects models that support quality scaling (ie: slimmable NAM A2 models); ignored otherwise. The value persists and is applied to any model loaded afterward.
